content.text:
I submitted **index 0 (In 0.874 / Sb 0.126)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.112%, the highest of the three I measured.

| Index | In fraction | EQE (%) | Phases seen by XRD |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 | 0.49 | 0.053 | Rutile InSbO4, trace In2O3 at most |
| 5 | 0.80 | 0.073 | InSbO4 + In2O3 |
| 0 | 0.87 | 0.112 | InSbO4 + the strongest In2O3 signal |

I used all 5 XRD scans (indices 0, 5, 10, 15, 24) to map phases along the line. The InSbO4 phase shows up everywhere. In2O3 peaks get stronger as the In fraction rises and are essentially absent at the Sb-rich end (index 24). EQE rose in step with the In2O3 content, so I spent the last measurement on the most In-rich composition, and it came out best.

- **Untested between points:** the trend is based on only three points. The true best could sit somewhere between compositions I tested (for example indices 1–4), which I couldn't check.
- **Sb-rich end not measured:** I didn't measure EQE there (indices 20–27). I ruled it out because it has no In2O3 and EQE was falling as Sb increased.
